query: Across national Centre-Based Care transport quartiles, compare Q1 and Q4 on Below Meeting NQS rate and median approved places.

answer.answer:
National Centre-Based Care comparison:

| Transport quartile | Below Meeting NQS rate | Median approved places |
|---|---:|---:|
| Q1 (closest transport access) | 7.5% | 60 |
| Q4 (farthest transport access) | 10.9% | 53.5 |

Q4’s Below Meeting rate is higher, while its median authorised capacity is lower than Q1’s. This is an association only; it does not establish that transport access causes quality or capacity differences.

evidence.claim: National Centre-Based Care Q1 had a 7.47% Below Meeting rate and median 60 approved places; Q4 had a 10.86% Below Meeting rate and median 53.5 approved places.

methodology: Compared the tool’s national Centre-Based Care transport-access quartiles; Q1 is closest and Q4 is farthest.
limitations: Approved places are authorised capacity, not enrolment, utilisation, waitlists, demand, or unmet need.
Quartile patterns are descriptive and do not establish causation.

data.caveat: Approved places are authorised capacity only. They do not establish actual demand, enrolment, waitlists, utilisation, or unmet need.
